_doc: Factory defaults for the SO-101 Suite. Nothing here is specific to one arm: every arm is calibrated by its owner. Your own changes are stored in ~/.so101/config.json (the effective values are defaults + your changes, see GET /api/suite/defaults).

serial._doc: How the computer talks to the motors. The STS3215 servos ship at 1 Mbit/s with ID 1, and the SO-101 uses IDs 1 to 6 from the base to the gripper.

calibration._doc: Calibration teaches an arm where the middle of each joint is. 0 = the middle of the range you recorded (LeRobot's convention). ticks_per_turn is the motor's 12-bit position scale (0 to 4095 is one full turn).

safety._doc: Limits that keep the arm and the motors safe. Loads are percent of a motor's maximum torque. The limit values are built in and are not changeable from the settings API; confirm_before_move and speed_preset are the user's choices.

cameras._doc: How cameras are opened. Pictures are requested at this size; the pick & place vision and the camera mapping assume 640x480. stale_after_s is how long without a new picture before the app says the camera is lost.

server._doc: Where the web app listens. 127.0.0.1 means this computer only (the safe default: the app has no password). Use --host 0.0.0.0 to let other devices on your network open it, for example a Raspberry Pi screen.

ui._doc: Look and feel. units: 'deg' shows joint angles in degrees with 0 at the middle, 'lerobot' shows LeRobot's -100..+100 scale. onboarded: once true, the address / opens the dashboard instead of the welcome page. calibrationPrompted: set once the first-time calibration offer has been shown.

adv._doc: Advanced switches. disabledModules lists module ids that are installed but turned off. trace* control the Inspector: trace starts recording when the app launches, traceRaw also records raw bytes, traceMax is how many entries are kept in memory.
